brief: Dubai’s white-and-blue octagonal residential tower with mapped offset shaft, three facade zones,48 triangular duplex balconies with plunge basins, an open four-canopy crown, slender capped mast and decorated fan/lattice podium.

sourceFacts.architect: Architect Hafeez Contractor; KEO International Consultants

reconstruction.massing: Exact-QID podium plus independent exact-QID octagonal tower and circular mast outlines preserve the shaft’s offset within its base. Current CVU392.4m architectural/tip and313.5m occupied heights override inconsistent39/393/395m map values; the architect rounds total height to393m.
reconstruction.facade: Eight original architect photographs establish white vertical frames, deep blue glazing, broad intermediate belts and the different upper-duplex facade. Four cardinal facets each carry twelve triangular projecting terraces with physical slabs, glass guards and shallow static plunge basins.
reconstruction.crown: The completed architect close photographs show four pale triangular canopies alternating with open steel-braced slots, above a blue glazed lower taper. The model preserves those openings around the central slender white mast and its small pyramidal cap.
reconstruction.entry: The architect’s close street photograph establishes the gray stone frame, interlocking rosette screens, large white fan ribs, slanted blue glazing and upper W braces. Lobby fit-out, planting and signage are outside the exterior geometry.

limitations: Original 452069-triangle, 52876084-byte master remains exactly reproducible from unchanged recipe. Reviewed source/four browser levels retain independently mapped asymmetric podium, offset octagonal shaft/mast, white/blue facade zones and belts, 48 triangular terrace slabs, open four-canopy crown, braced slots and 392.4 m capped mast. Whole backing planes, continuous seam strips and two-faced flat strips for narrow near trim and crossed skyline strips replace separately framed cells. Close-up/street reconstruct the podium lattice with aggregated coarse six-petal motifs with hexagonal close-up and four-sided street petal loops rather than every tiny original petal; district keeps two solid outer fan ribs per bay, sparse beams and averaged lattice colour but omits pool basins and terrace top rails; skyline keeps white vertical corner frames, averages podium/trim colour and omits small screens, rails, pool basins, collars, canopy louvers and thin X bracing. Near terrace guards and static plunge basins remain explicit. Two canonical shared graphs approximate gray stone and white coated metal; four near draw groups, zero images. Exact floor/panel schedule, canopy datum, ornamental spacing, pool dimensions and door bay are reconstructions from architect photos. Architect introductory 380 m wording differs from final 393 m factbox and current CVU 392.4 m; completed dimension controls tip. Lobby interiors, landscaping, lettering and swimming simulation excluded. Finite along-ray 1.5/.75/.3/.1 m allowances exclude omitted/aggregated thin screens, mullions, rails and collars; no global surface-distance, physical-device or surveyed-grade claim.

geographic.reviewStatus: reviewed medium-fi signed placement with reconstructed entry
geographic.orientationConfidence: exact independent offset shaft/mast and asymmetric podium
geographic.notes: Fresh OSM API on 2026-10-10 confirms exact Q216264 podium 186351097, independent octagonal shaft 907717855 and mast 186351102; all geometry matches map-parts. Signed heading -0.72546838218 puts +X southeast and +Z southwest. The independently offset shaft/mast and asymmetric fifth podium edge fix the registration phase; an unsigned long axis alone would not. Architect completed photos show diagonal broad blue facets alternating with native cardinal balcony faces and open four-canopy crown. Door bay on native -Z (northeast) podium front remains photograph-based reconstruction, not a surveyed entrance point; no doorway-bearing claim. Source Y=0 is reconstructed street datum and tip 392.4 m follows CVU record rather than inconsistent 39/393/395 m map tags. Accept 2 m footprint / 1 degree reconstruction allowance; automatic footprint replacement disabled.
